name: Intermediate Push Workout
description: This workout focuses on chest, triceps, and shoulders using various exercises to build strength and muscle definition.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: A classic chest exercise that also engages the triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and lower it to your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Targets the shoulders while also engaging the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells directly above your head until your arms are extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.description: An effective bodyweight exercise to target the triceps.
instructions: Using parallel bars, support your body with arms extended and feet off the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until they are at a 90-degree angle.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.description: Focuses on the chest muscles with an incline angle.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells above your chest with slightly bent arms.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Bring the dumbbells back up above your chest.

exercises.name: Side Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Isolates the side deltoids to enhance shoulder definition.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells by your sides, palms facing in.
Raise the dumbbells to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows until shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.description: A bodyweight exercise that engages the chest, triceps, and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest touches the ground.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
